body.construction: Starting from the published two-stage school assignment law, exposure mapping, and direct-effect score, quotient assignments and observable subsets by exact design automorphisms, introduce separator-local Boolean Mobius states, and require a rational lifting map that preserves every global domination inequality and observable margin; the solver determines whether a lossless bounded-width decomposition and a useful block exist.
